strings: Poor m_c walks into the medicine den in a daze. When r_c0 asks {PRONOUN/m_c/object} what's wrong, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can only splutter an explanation about being unable to move when initially waking.

m_c has been struggling recently. When {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/wake/wakes} up, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/find/finds} {PRONOUN/m_c/self} unable to move and seeing things lurking just beyond the den.
Even when sleeping in the middle of the den surrounded by {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates, m_c doesn't seem to be able to escape the figures that find {PRONOUN/m_c/object} in the early morning.
